data.body: 1104 test-contract card: authoritative contract = ticket ACs plus parent 2f79 continuity requirement. Preconditions = real git repo with configured sync remote, additive or corrupt refs/reconciler/gate blob, and for workflow tests the actual Run reconciler shell body. Production paths = set_pause CAS seam; real rebar bridge subprocess; real rebar_reconciler subprocess; parsed/executed production workflow shell. Tiers = unit contract for blob/CAS, real CLI + temporary repos for parsing/refs/exit codes, and workflow contract execution; lower tiers miss serialization, remote refs, or shell outputs. Postconditions = exact additive blob, exact marker/exit, observed-oid deletion, and paused commit-skip. Collateral invariants = lock/tickets refs and tracker bytes unchanged. Negative controls = legacy gated_mode-only behavior, reconcile-check early return, ordinary rc 0, malformed/unanchored markers, and unrelated sentinel verb. Recovery = corrupt resume clears then normal pause can succeed. Fault injection = CAS movement at the existing single-shot seam; no new contention harness because each operation is one existing CAS. Gate = targeted pytest nodes plus make test/CI.
